'''Project: Nightsaber''' was a program led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vit]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. The plan was to recruit [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to create a cadre of loyal [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[Dal Konur]] worked with Vit, who was using him as an opportunity to get close to the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]].

Dal Konur was apprehended by agents of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and General Vit [[Death/Legends|died]] in the fight. Project Nightsaber died with him.
